evidence: Dimethylzinc·TMEDA was introduced into the reaction chamber by using Ar carrier gas through a bubbling cylinder kept at a constant temperature and pressure. A NiO film was coated in a commercial ALD reactor on the ZnO nanorod by using ALD reactions of Ni(dmamp)2 as the nickel source and H2O as the oxygen source. Argon was used as a carrier and purge gas.
